name: FMP
description: Real-time and historical financial data through a suite of tools covering stocks, ETFs, crypto, forex, commodities, SEC filings, economic indicators, and more. Users can look up company fundamentals, pull financial statements, screen stocks, read earnings transcripts, track insider and congressional trades, and more. Elevate your financial analysis and investment research with trusted, institutional-quality data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FMP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FMP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://financialmodelingprep.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FMP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FMP lists 27 MCP tools, including ESG, Fundraisers, analyst, calendar, chart, commitmentOfTraders, commodity, company, crypto, directory, discountedCashFlow, and earningsTranscript.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FMP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FMP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
FMP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FMP is developed by Financial Modeling Prep. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
